1Password suggests updating Safari

Safari is available in a new version. 1Password works best with up-to-date browsers.

Current version: Safari to
Safari 18.6 is now available. Updating takes only a moment.

This update includes security improvements and bug fixes. It also increases the
minimum required macOS version, increasing the
minimum supported version to Sequoia.

To update:

  1. Open System Settings
  2. Click General > Software Update
  3. Install the update

After updating, Safari 18.6 will be used by default for compatible browser extensions.

If you need help, visit our support site.

— The 1Password Team
